hints.title: Running Reduction Invariant
hints.text: Each tested device decrements the battery percentage of all subsequent untested devices by 1.

hints.title: Effective Battery Value
hints.text: Maintain tested_count. For device i, its current battery is max(0, batteryPercentages[i] - tested_count).

hints.title: Conditional Increment
hints.text: If the effective battery is strictly greater than 0, increment tested_count and proceed.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass tracking scalar decrement count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Decrementing all future elements in an inner loop takes O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Track accumulated decrement count as a single offset variable.
